definition: NIGP class with focus-window spend >= $1,000,000 where one vendor holds >= 90% of spend
NIGP class with spend >= $1,000,000 and vendor HHI >= 2,500 (not already R1)
Vendor holding >= 5% of all focus-window spend
NIGP class with >= 10 standalone orders (contract- or PO-type, no master agreement referenced) totalling >= $250,000 in the focus window
Comparable item-year with lines priced >= 1.5x the item-year median unit price
Comparable item whose median unit price rose >= 25% from one fiscal year to the next
OTIF fell >= 10% points from the prior 12 months to the last 12 months (>= 30 due lines in each)
Lead-time standard deviation >= 5.0 days with >= 20 completed lines
Rejected / received quantity >= 2% with >= 30 due lines
Spend-weighted paid price >= 10% above contracted standard price
Open (not cancelled, not short-closed, not fully received) line past its promised date at the as-of date
Sole supplier in a category, or >= 60% of a category's spend, or >= 15% of total spend
